Make the Windows VR game `<the game named after the command>` run on VXRuntime.

1. If no game was named, list the installed games (vxrt MCP `list_games`, or `python3 tools/vxrt_run.py --list`) and ask which one; stop until the user answers.
2. Get the brief: `python3 tools/vxrt_doctor.py "<the game named after the command>" --goal support --lang en --agent cursor`. It gives the goal, when the task is done, the facts, the tools to use first, the rules and when to stop. Follow it.
3. Talk to the user in their language.
